result.title: A Stationarity-Based Regret Framework for Time-Varying Nonconvex Composite Optimization
result.summary: This paper studies time-varying nonconvex composite optimization, where decisions are made sequentially and classical value-based regret notions are generally ill-posed. We introduce a stationarity-based performance framework defined through local regret measures built from first-order optimality conditions, and identify minimal structural requirements under which such measures constitute sound performance criteria. This abstraction encompasses canonical optimality measures, including the proximal-gradient residual, and collapses to classical dynamic regret in convex settings. We then focus on the proximal-gradient residual as a concrete and algorithmically meaningful instantiation for general composite problems. In convex problems, we show that the resulting local regret is equivalent to standard dynamic regret. In nonconvex settings, we establish that sublinear stationarity-based regret is unattainable without temporal regularity, and introduce a gradient-variation budget that captures this necessity. Under this model, we analyze online proximal-gradient methods and prove sublinear regret guarantees in both nested multi-call and fully incremental single-call oracle regimes, highlighting the tradeoff between per-round computational effort and achievable performance. Finally, we demonstrate how the proposed framework extends to nonconvex multiplayer games by interpreting equilibrium-seeking dynamics through stationarity-based regret, and corroborate the theoretical findings with numerical experiments.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究时变非凸复合优化，提出以局部平稳性（一阶最优性条件）定义的 regret 框架，并分析 proximal-gradient 方法在嵌套多调用与完全增量单调用 oracle 下的次线性 regret 保证及计算与性能的权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉或多模态推理无直接联系，但「多调用 vs 单调用」的逐步计算预算与动态目标下的局部最优性度量，可能为 latent 多步/循环推理中评估每步计算收益、收敛与停止判据提供形式化参照，值得核查其度量是否可移植。
